# routine

```go
import routine "ganigeorgiev.com/pocketbase/pocketbase/tools/routine"
```

Source: [`tools/routine`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/tools/routine).

## Functions

### FireAndForget

```go
func FireAndForget(f func(), wg ...*sync.WaitGroup)
```

FireAndForget executes f() in a new go routine and auto recovers if panic.

\*\*Note:\*\* Use this only if you are not interested in the result of f() and don't want to block the parent go routine.

### SafeWrap

```go
func SafeWrap(f func() error) func() error
```

SafeWrap wraps the provided function with auto panic recover handling and returns any eventual panic as regular error.
